stage: Pasting an invitation for a changed address navigates to its own host and pairs
checks: Visible invitation is complete and copy delivers the exact capability link
Denied clipboard exposes a selected complete-link fallback
Bare phone address has a usable invitation field and remains unauthorized
Incomplete, private PC and unsafe invitation URLs cannot exchange credentials
Pasted complete link reaches code entry and survives a refresh without its hash
Expired pending invitation is discarded and shows link recovery
Replaced invitation has a direct recovery path using the new link and code
Additional independently paired browser joins the same session
Session shortcut shows all three online browsers and safe access controls
Both paired browsers can edit and save the host project
Both paired browsers use the same actual host shell
Phone session list is accessible and signing out preserves other devices and shell
Public HTTPS entry and invitation refresh keep the same recovery behavior
Pasting an invitation for a changed address navigates to its own host and pairs
limitations: Desktop-hosted browser emulation, not a physical phone.
Local real pairing plus public-entry browser routing; no public connector is started.
Clipboard is controlled for success/denial cases; real operating-system clipboard delivery is not measured.
